notes.title: Idle Run Aya V1.1
notes.notes: [h1][b]💙 Idle Run Aya – Patch Notes v1.1[/b][/h1][h2]🚀 [b]Performance & Technical Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*][p]The [b]pedometer[/b] no longer updates in real time, but at intervals – this significantly improves performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Additional optimizations for even smoother gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Scrolling behavior fixed[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]More measures added to prevent [b]"out of bounds"[/b] bugs.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor [b]sound fixes[/b] included.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🐾 [b]New Content & Features[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]New pets added[/b] – more than 6 cute companions await![/p][/*][*][p][b]Butterfly click mechanic[/b] introduced for extra interaction (optional).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Secret bonus level[/b] added – can you find it?[/p][/*][*][p]A [b]hidden easter egg[/b] has been added.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Idle animation[/b] added – Aya now stretches occasionally when standing still.[/p][/*][*][p]New [b]"Hide Front Layer"[/b] button for a cleaner view.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Random zone generator[/b] completely reworked:[/p][list][*][p]Layers now match more naturally.[/p][/*][*][p]Includes several new layers exclusive to the generator.[/p][/*][*][p]Now also works at [b]night[/b] and during [b]rain[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🎨 [b]Visual & UI Enhancements[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Font has been changed for improved readability.[/p][/*][*][p]Textbox design updated.[/p][/*][*][p]Visual feedback for interactables:[/p][list][*][p]Clickable objects now [b]glow green[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Non-clickable objects no longer light up.[/p][/*][*][p]Bonus step objects now [b]visibly marked[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]End sequence[/b] now correctly displays [b]all unlocked hair colors[/b].[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🧠 [b]Gameplay & Balance Adjustments[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Level-ups[/b] now grant a reward every time.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Buff system reworked:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Eating is now only possible at [b]full speed[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Unusable buffs are now [b]grayed out[/b] for better clarity.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Buffs can now be toggled individually.[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Base stamina[/b] increased: from [b]30 to 50[/b] – longer running without resting.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]📸 [b]Interactions & Dialogue Updates[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Photographer interaction:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Clicking him now [b]destroys his camera[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]If he manages to take a photo, he will [b]proudly hang it up[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Mood bar[/b] added:[/p][list][*][p]Tracks Aya’s current state of mind.[/p][/*][*][p]Affects her [b]bust-click dialogues[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Staying uncovered drains the bar – she starts confident but grows snappier over time.[/p][/*][*][p]Wearing clothes again [b]refills the bar quickly[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Bust-click dialogue[/b] added to the main menu.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🛠️ [b]Miscellaneous Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Various [b]minor bug fixes[/b] and polish applied.[/p][/*][/list]
